detail.reuse_scope: Exact additive-energy decomposition of sphere point sets.
detail.statement_one_line: Every ordered pair `(u,v)`, `u+v≠0`, is an antipodal pair of exactly one sphere-circle (carrier `(u+v)/2`); ordered pairs partition by carriers, `Σ w² = λ′² Σ_C Ψ_C²`.

detail.statement_one_line: For sphere-circle-supported trig sums, `Σ_{t≠0} w_t² ≤ 14 λ′² I_c²` for ANY amplitudes/n/height; constant 14 sharp (rings attain `14−18/n`).

detail.reuse_scope: Any matched-cumulant fluctuation operator with a real scalar order parameter; replaces Gershgorin row bounds by an exact structural floor.
detail.statement_one_line: The matched second-cumulant off-diagonal transfer operator is `W = λ′(P²−2I·Id)`, `P=Σ A_u S_u` self-adjoint ⇒ `D+W = D₀+λ′P² ≥ D₀ > 0` unconditionally; n-free, pattern-free spectral floor `−2λ′I/r̂`.
